sections_target.text: Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, to be performed every six months or when damages occur on any part as indicated by M6 in the title block
This document used for the following cranes:
The 150 ton crane is used for lifting and lowering the bulkhead gates in front of the intake gates of the turbine units.

The first draft was initiated by Eng. Zakaria Mohamed Abdelrahim, tested by Eng. Osama Ahmed Hassanain, accepted by General Director Eng. Haseb Hesain Bahboh, and approved by Eng. Mohamed Abd Elbast; Head Sector of Aswan ( 1 & 2 ) Power Station, and certified by Eng. Kamel Ragheb: HPGC quality control General Manager and MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, belts, work gloves
Turn off the electric power to the crane before carrying out maintenance.

Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.

Hand held radio wave for communication.

items: Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.
Hand held radio wave for communication.
Screw driver kit and test leads.
Antistatic vacuum cleaner for dust cleaning.

sections_target.text: Work to be Done
Switch off main CB.
Check the contacts for main and aux. contactors and clean it by using spray.
Check limit switch for trolley &hoist and crane movement (terminal & contacts).
Check emergency limit switch (terminal & contacts).
Check the contacts and terminals for joystick of trolley, hoist and crane movement.
Switch on main CB.
Check trolley movement and its limit switch function.
Check hoist movement and its limit switch function.
Check crane movement and its limit switch function.
Place a copy of test results in the crane data file.

uncertain_terms.note: The source document is largely in English already (mixed Arabic headings and English body); the English source text is kept verbatim and only the Arabic parts were translated.
Header table reads 'القوة المحطة' / 'التقنية الإجراء' – garbled; rendered as 'Power Station' / 'Technical Procedure' by inference from the MPIS header pattern.
The cranes table header 'يكتب' (literally 'writes') is unclear; rendered as 'Type' by inference. The values in that column ('I & C') are kept verbatim.
Footer reads 'Crane شفرة:' – 'شفرة' rendered as 'code'; the intended field label is unclear (possibly 'Crane code:').
